artifact_contract.partial_promotion: one independent record may be accepted without accepting other records

data.heldout_role: all path endpoints and induced sequences are held-out real images; no physical trajectory claim
data.pair_selection: balanced same/different-label held-out pairs selected by RNG seed before scoring; no selection by latent distance, density, or observed benchmark output

integration.geodesic: DensityGeodesic + GeodesicConfig(n_points=24, max_iter=300, step_size=0.3, tol=1e-5, density_exponent=1.0); report metric as iterations
integration.manifold: mean train-only GMM log-density along each 24-point held-out LERP path; labels are evaluation-only
integration.pose: existing SO3/SE3/PoseTrajectory focused controls remain supporting coverage, not physical trajectory evidence
integration.projection: existing SubspaceProjection contract remains a supporting focused control; no new abstraction
integration.temporal: Trajectory + smooth_trajectory with a triangular window=5; each of 128 independent held-out pair paths supplies one monotone 32-point query

density.fit_scope: train latents only; held-out latents are score-only

provenance_contract.package_versions: record exact uv.lock-resolved versions at execution

records.failure: Fail this record when held-out ranking, the shuffled-label sanity control, or the strong raw-pixel reference comparison misses its threshold.
Fail this record when any spherical endpoint, norm, angle, shape/dtype, finiteness, or no-mutation control fails.
Fail this record on endpoint, coefficient, shape/dtype, finiteness, or no-mutation failure.
Fail this record when the bounded optimizer does not converge, endpoints drift, values are non-finite, or the path falls materially below the LERP density baseline.
Fail this record when any spherical endpoint, norm, angle, shape/dtype, finiteness, or no-mutation control fails.
Fail this record when 128 independent held-out pair-path trials do not beat indexwise and deranged unrelated-pair controls, or temporal outputs violate shape/dtype/finiteness/no-mutation checks.

resource_contract.cleanup: retain immutable artifact/run record; remove only temporary plots/cache if any

trajectory_semantics.chance_control: deterministic derangement of the 128 held-out pair paths using a seed derived from 42; no pair path maps to itself
trajectory_semantics.frechet: not available in the stable project API; no Frechet claim or invented implementation
trajectory_semantics.label: model-induced latent sequences from held-out real sklearn digits samples
trajectory_semantics.warp: each held-out 24-point latent pair path is monotonically resampled into its own 32-point unequal-length query

artifact_schema.status: created only by an explicit committed run
artifact_schema.verdicts: independent per-record outcomes with optional partial promotion

run_record_schema.status: created only by an explicit committed run

chance.method: balanced pair scores with labels permuted by RNG seed 42; trajectory positives and deranged unrelated-pair negatives are scored independently
chance.acceptance: report; shuffled-label AUC must remain within +/-0.10 of 0.50

shuffled.method: fixed permutation of held-out labels and deterministic derangement of the 128 held-out pair paths
shuffled.acceptance: must not produce a positive claim; report exact derangement and pair-path digests

strong.method: raw-pixel Euclidean endpoint/path score on the same held-out pairs, with any density fit train-only
strong.acceptance: latent pair-ranking AUC must be no more than 0.05 below this reference; report both
strong.rationale: five AUC points is a predeclared practical-equivalence margin, not a claim of superiority

trajectory_alignment.method: fixed indexwise distance is the non-warping reference; each pair path has a monotone 32-point query, and DTW must improve indexwise plus deranged unrelated-pair controls
trajectory_alignment.acceptance: median self-to-indexwise <= 0.95 and median self-to-unrelated <= 0.90 across 128 independent trials

determinism_contract.rng: np.random.default_rng(42) for split, pair selection, and controls
determinism_contract.repeat: execute the design-approved runner twice and require identical payload digest before promotion
determinism_contract.mutation: snapshot all input arrays and require byte-identical inputs after every record computation
